svg.title: More builds and case studies. AI Discovery Engine: collects reviews and comments from six public sources (Google Play, YouTube, Steam, GitHub Issues, Hacker News and RSS) and turns them into ranked pain points and opportunities. AI Grocery Shopping Assistant: AI constrained to the live catalog, deployed and publicly usable, with a FastAPI companion build. Wealth Coach AI: a planning tool for first time Indian investors, deployed on Streamlit Cloud. ChatGPT voice input growth strategy: from 30 plus surveyed users, 42 percent knew voice existed, 28 percent had tried it, 6 percent used it regularly; North Star target 6 to 25 percent weekly active voice users in three months. n8n onboarding teardown: the largest estimated drop, 27 points, sits between entering the dashboard and creating a first node. Engati and Canara Bank: a Day 0 pitch to Day 180 renewal business case with a six KPI scorecard agreed up front. Eureka by ALLEN: a localisation first fix to a monetisation timing problem. Funnel numbers in case studies are estimates or scenario assumptions.

section.h2: Products built end to end, and teardowns with numbers.

div.h3: ChatGPT voice input: India growth strategy
div.p: 30+ surveyed users and in depth interviews. The barrier was reversibility, not capability.
North Star: weekly active voice users, 6% to 25% in three months.
Survey, then a video, then a blank canvas. In an estimated funnel from PLG benchmarks, the biggest drop is blank canvas paralysis.
North Star: time to first successful workflow run.
Reviews from six public sources (Play, YouTube, Steam, GitHub Issues, HN, RSS) become ranked pain points and opportunities.
AI constrained to the live catalog, demo mode without a key, plus a FastAPI companion build.
Allocation planner and growth simulator for first time Indian investors. Educational, not advice.
Day 0 pitch to Day 180 renewal, judged on a six KPI scorecard agreed up front.
Let students learn in their own language before asking them to commit.
None of these have real world users. Case study funnels are estimates or scenario assumptions.
